concept: Review and integration: what noticing how things connect feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of cause and effect, parts working together, and repeating patterns — which is easiest for you to spot?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'systems thinking' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
